gloss: person radical (亻); the left-hand "person" radical in kanji

definitions.gloss: person radical (亻); the left-hand "person" radical in kanji
definitions.explanation: The kanji radical {亻|にんべん}, a stylized form of {人|ひと} (person) that appears on the left side of many kanji. It is one of the most common left-side radicals ({偏|へん}) and generally signals that the kanji has some connection to people or human activity, as in {休|やす}む, {作|つく}る, {住|す}む, and {使|つか}う.

examples.japanese: 「{休|やす}」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧にんべん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧だ。
examples.english: "休" is a kanji with the person radical.

examples.japanese: にんべん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The person radical is often used in kanji related to people.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧にんべん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えないで→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't confuse the person radical in this character with the tree radical.
Write "tree" next to the person radical and it reads as "yasumu" (to rest).

notes:
The name literally means "⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧-⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧" (person-left-side-radical). にんべん is written in hiragana far more often than in kanji, because the word is usually cited when spelling out or describing a character out loud.

USAGE:
Native speakers commonly identify kanji in conversation by naming the radical plus another component: にんべん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧」("person radical + tree = ⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧"). This is a practical way to clarify which kanji you mean — for example, when giving your name over the phone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- にんべん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧: a kanji with the person radical
- にんべん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜: person radical next to 〜 (used when spelling kanji aloud)
- にんべん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to have the person radical attached

KANJI WITH THIS RADICAL:
Common examples include ⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧ (rest), ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (make), ⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (live), ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (use), ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (body), ⟦{代|か}わる→代わる：11718_kawaru⟧ (replace), ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧ (what), and many more.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦きへん→きへん：23625_kihen⟧: tree radical (⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧), a left-side radical seen in ⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧, ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧, ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧, etc.
- ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧: the general term for any left-side radical
- ⟦{旁|つくり}→旁：23626_tsukuri⟧: right-side component of a kanji
- ⟦{部首|ぶしゅ}→部首：00023_bushu⟧: radical (general term for kanji components used in dictionary lookup)
